## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Verification

List the exact backend tests, frontend tests/build, or documentation checks run.

## Documentation and data safety

- [ ] Public behavior/configuration changes are documented.
- [ ] No credential, private source, prompt, machine path, or unredacted run artifact is included.
- [ ] Generated figures/results are unchanged, or their provenance and denominator are documented.
- [ ] Plugin changes preserve the `app.catalog.sdk` boundary.
- [ ] I have read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
